record.statement: Prove that critical bond percolation on Z^2 at p = 1/2 is conformally invariant in the scaling limit (Cardy's formula and convergence of interfaces to SLE(6)), as is known on the triangular lattice by Smirnov.
record.status_search: Bounded search 2026-09-07: no proof of conformal invariance on Z^2 found; the problem is listed as open in Duminil-Copin's ICM 2018 survey as well (dedup with that source).
record.title: Conformal invariance of critical bond percolation on the square lattice

record.author: claude-probability-1000-continue-0907
record.method: Look for a discrete holomorphic observable on the square lattice analogous to Smirnov's on the triangular lattice.
record.obstruction: Only the weak (contour) half of discrete holomorphicity holds for the q=1 parafermion on the square lattice.
record.result: Smirnov's argument needs the three-arm colour-switching symmetry, which on the triangular lattice comes from site self-duality; on Z^2 bond percolation the dual is the shifted square lattice and the exploration interface lives on the medial lattice, where the parafermionic observable F(z) = E[e^{i sigma W(z)} 1_{z on interface}] with spin sigma = ... satisfies only half of the discrete Cauchy-Riemann relations (the contour-integral relations, as for FK models with q not 2). A concrete check: for the q=1 FK model the parafermionic observable has spin sigma = 2/3 and the relation sum over edges around a face vanishes, which gives crossing exponent bounds but not holomorphicity; the missing half is what conformal invariance needs. No new observable found.

record.body:
ATTEMPT RECORD, author-checked only, from the 2026-09-07 intake. Method: Check which ingredients of the q = 2 proof are available for other q. Result: The q = 2 proof uses (i) the parafermionic observable being discretely holomorphic (full Cauchy-Riemann), (ii) RSW-type crossing estimates for tightness, (iii) identification of the limit via the martingale observable. For q in (1,4) not 2: (ii) is available (Duminil-Copin-Sidoravicius-Tassion 2017 for q in [1,4]); (iii) would follow from (i); (i) fails: for general q the observable satisfies only the contour relations (half of the Cauchy-Riemann equations), the same obstruction as in C0017. So the conjecture is reduced, for q in [1,4], exactly to finding an additional discrete relation for the parafermionic observable; the count of unknowns versus equations (one complex relation per face versus two needed) is the precise deficit. For q < 1 even RSW is unavailable. No new relation found. Obstruction: Discrete holomorphicity is only half-satisfied for q not 2.
Refers to the open problem node open-problem-c0049-convergence-of-random-cluster-interfaces-to-sle-kappa-for-q-in-0-4-q-n
